blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: refinement — Improving model for new requirements.
validity — Whether model works for its intended use.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Compare the simplification against new requirements. If the model omits a relevant factor it can produce plausible but wrong outputs.

blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: Refine the abstraction by adding only the newly necessary variable, rather than reconstructing every real-world detail.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Test normal, boundary and exceptional cases: 5 km versus 6 km, return and single, and invalid negative distance.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain
blocks.text: Weekend becomes a relevant distinction because it can change the output.
